subject: TracingControlMvcController / TracingControlManagementContextConfiguration Servlet-vs-WebFlux scope

currentImplementation.reason: TracingControlManagementContextConfiguration depends directly on org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.WebMvcConfigurer (Spring MVC) for absolute-path composition (configurePathMatch/addPathPrefix). No reactive equivalent has been implemented.
currentImplementation.reactiveBehavior: Control API (TracingControlMvcController, tracingControlPathPrefixConfigurer, and the whole TracingControlManagementContextConfiguration bean definition) is PHYSICALLY ABSENT — not merely inactive — on any classpath lacking spring-webmvc, including a pure WebFlux (spring-webflux, no spring-webmvc) application.
currentImplementation.managementContextTypeNote: ManagementContextType (from @ManagementContextConfiguration) only distinguishes SAME/CHILD/ANY management-context topology, not Servlet vs WebFlux web stack. Servlet-vs-WebFlux isolation here is therefore enforced entirely by @ConditionalOnClass(WebMvcConfigurer.class), not by ManagementContextType.

verifiedAbsenceScenarios.reason: @ConditionalOnClass(WebMvcConfigurer.class) fails — proves the Servlet-only contract self-deactivates rather than failing unpredictably on a reactive-only classpath

verifiedPresenceScenario.note: Real two-port SpringApplication boot; controller and configuration beans confirmed present in the management CHILD ApplicationContext specifically (not merely routable), custom management.endpoints.web.base-path applied, route reachable on the management port, absent on the application port, readiness probe reaches RUNNING only after a successful readAcceptedComplete.

decision: SUPERSEDED AS CLOSURE PATH. Current Servlet-only behavior remains the implemented and tested baseline, but plan §14.7 forbids Servlet-only as the product end-state. P4-WF is the required closure path (WebFlux parity). P4-WF.0 census and P4-WF.1 minimal design (MINIMAL_DESIGN_ACCEPTED) are complete without production code; implementation waits on P4-WF.2 class-budget Codex gate. Evidence: docs/research/evidence/p4-webflux-parity/.

p4ClosureImpact.note: Committee ratification of Servlet-only permanent limitation is no longer an acceptable P4 closure path under the plan. Formal closure requires P4-WF.2–P4-WF.7 (class-budget, implementation, parity/absence tests, reactive Docker E2E) plus PRIV-R07.

committeeDecisionItems: Do not ratify Servlet-only as permanent product limitation for P4 closure
Track WebFlux parity completion via P4-WF gates (see docs/research/evidence/p4-webflux-parity/ and p4-closure-status)
